object.name: evi.wavefolder~
object.digest: Antialiased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, simultaneous outputs up to four stages
object.description: An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative antialiasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'simple' version has a fixed cascade of 4 stages, 3 stages, 2 stages or 1 stage, available at four different outlets. See <o>evi.wavefolder.cascade~</o> for a version with more options.
object.discussion: Based on the paper and initial Max example: 'Virtual Analog Model of the Lockhart Wavefolder' by Fabian Esqueda, Henri Pontynen, Julian D. Parker, Stefan Bilbao, SMC, 2017.

inlets.description: Audio input to be wavefolded, typically a simple oscillator.
